title: Model results: candidate catalog + measured/skipped model arms (sizes from files, never vendor tables)

configuration.telemetry: none — benchmark harness performs no network calls unless an adapter explicitly opts in via env
configuration.needleTelemetry: NEEDLE_TELEMETRY=0 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 mandated for any Needle execution (see docs/ai/needle-evaluation.md)
configuration.inference: recorded ONNX run (2026-08-27) — no re-inference in this environment

dataset.origin: plantvillage-eval (120-image hold-out: 6 classes × 20; Tomato/Potato/Pepper — NO rice classes)
dataset.groundTruthNote: public benchmark labels; performance on PlantVillage ≠ field accuracy

latencyMs.note: deterministic text/rule path latency in node; ONNX WASM latency measured in-browser (not available here)

arms.label: Quantized variant (INT8 dynamic) of current ONNX
arms.skipReason: requires onnxruntime + python export pipeline run (not executed in this environment)
arms.howToRun: python backend/eval/export_and_eval.py --help  # re-export from checkpoint; add dynamic_quantize step, then re-run this benchmark

arms.label: Small MobileNet-family candidate
arms.skipReason: no rice-capable lightweight checkpoint is committed to the repo; training/export required
arms.howToRun: train MobileNetV3-Small on the agreed rice dataset (Phase 2), export ONNX, add rows here

arms.label: Other lightweight vision candidates (EfficientNet-lite, ResNet-18)
arms.skipReason: candidate selection deferred to Rice Phase 2 dataset availability

arms.label: H. Needle only (structured extraction / intent / clarification)
arms.howToRun: pip install cactus-needle   # then: NEEDLE_MODEL_PATH=<path/needle3.cact> KV_BENCH_NEEDLE=1 npx vitest run eval/mobile-ai

arms.label: N. Best measured arm + Qwen/WebLLM in-browser LLM
arms.skipReason: WebLLM/Qwen requires a WebGPU browser session; not executable from the node harness
arms.howToRun: open the KrishiVerse PWA in a WebGPU browser with VITE_ENABLE_ONDEVICE_LLM=auto, or serve the model via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and set KV_BENCH_LLM_URL to reuse the same adapter

arms.label: O. Best measured arm + smallest local LLM (OpenAI-compatible local server)
arms.skipReason: KV_BENCH_LLM_URL not set (no local OpenAI-compatible server configured)

limitations: 6-class PlantVillage hold-out only; NO rice classes exist — no rice accuracy claim can be made.
Metrics re-derived from recorded predictions (models/onnx_eval_results.json), not a fresh inference run.
Top-3, ECE, quantized/MobileNet variants: not measured — commands recorded above.
Mobile latency/RAM: requires device run (see mobile.benchmark limitations).
Screening set: 0 expert-labelled cases — pass rates are pipeline screening signals, never accuracy.
Arms H–M skipped in this environment (cactus-needle not installed); N/O skipped (WebGPU session or KV_BENCH_LLM_URL) — see howToRun.
Wall-clock latency measured on a desktop reference (node), not on a low-end Android device.
Tamil/Tanglish expectations are word-level; agronomic correctness is governed by the KB, not by this set.
Desktop node measurements are a REFERENCE ONLY — do not quote them as mobile performance.
dist bundle bytes reflect the last local `npm run build` (null when dist/ absent).
Heap deltas are indicative (node V8), not Android RSS.
